messages.message: Solid all-round paper, Nikhil — Chemistry was your strongest section. Tighten Maths accuracy under time pressure and you're a top-3 contender next test.
Excellent Physics score, Aarav. A calmer approach to Chemistry negatives will close the gap to rank 1.
Outstanding paper, Ananya — rank 1 with a near-perfect Physics section. Keep this consistency going into the boards.
The negative marking hurt this attempt, Darshan. Let's revisit attempt strategy — skip low-confidence questions rather than guessing.
Good balance across subjects, Kavya. Maths needs a bit more speed — everything else is on track.
Manish, this one was tough on you — high negatives across the board. Let's schedule extra practice sessions before the next test.
Steady performance, Meghana. Chemistry is your edge — build Maths confidence to move up the rank list.
Room to grow, Pruthvi — focus on Maths fundamentals this cycle, the other two sections are close to solid.
Very strong test, Sneha — rank 3 with consistent scores everywhere. Keep this rhythm up.
Decent attempt, Varun. Prioritize accuracy over speed in Maths to cut down negative marking.
